people.name: David

people.name: Gad

translations.web: David went up according to the saying of Gad, as Yahweh commanded.
translations.bsb: So David went up at the word of Gad, just as the LORD had commanded.
translations.kjv: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the LORD commanded.
translations.asv: And David went up according to the saying of Gad, as Jehovah commanded.
